QuestInfo.name: Resting in Aurora
QuestInfo.0: You met the White Mage and arrived at the Aurora Great Temple. Looking back, it was quite a journey. Talk to Mars, the top magician.
QuestInfo.1: Arin looks worn out. She is quite young for this kind of journey.\r\n#b(Talk to Arin who is already at the lodge in the Great Temple.)#k
QuestInfo.2: Mars showed you where you'd be staying.

0.0: My name is #bMars#k. I am the top magician of Aurora, as I am sure you are aware. You are free to look around, but please do not take, touch, handle, lick, smell, or stare at anything. I do not want our light research disturbed.
0.1: On your right, you'll see the #bMaster's Lab#k. Alright, stop looking at it. You are fully prohibited from having anything to do with that lab.

yes.0: On your left, you will see the guest room. The child you came with is already resting. I suggest you do the same. And don't touch anything.\r\n#b(Enter the portal on the left.)#k

no.0: Please don't disrupt the research here.\r\n

1.0: Whew, it's been awhile since I got some real rest. Can't believe there's a place like this in the middle of a forest!\r\n#L0##bYou know, it was really dangerous out there. You should be more careful.#l\n#k
1.1: I know, I know. But all I really care about is getting rid of Omens. I'll push to the limit to rid the world of those things!\r\n#L0##bThere's no point risking your life if the monsters are too strong for you.#l\n#k
1.2: Hey, don't you lecture me. You do that all the time. But why are there so many Omens here? Is it the darkness?

yes.0: Oh, yeah. Hey, you!  I have something to give you.

npc.0: What was the child's name? Arin? Please take care of her.\r\n#b(Enter the portal on the left.)#k
